The days in a week, a month and a year

Source: R/fig_model.R
tfl_time_unit_days.Rd

The figure programs divide a time in days by named constants – days_per_week, days_per_month, days_per_year – not by numbers written in each program, so a company sets them once (a study's setup: tflplanner writes them from its company standards). These are the values used where none is set: the figure setup (tfl_fig_setup_code()) and a figure script of its own define a constant only when it is not defined yet. The programs say the name as it is (AVAL / days_per_month): a data column must not be named like one (tflplanner's review says so).

Usage

tfl_time_unit_days()

Value

A named numeric vector: days_per_week 7, days_per_month 30.4375 (365.25 / 12), days_per_year 365.25.

Examples

tfl_time_unit_days()
#>  days_per_week days_per_month  days_per_year 
#>         7.0000        30.4375       365.2500
